data.text: **Question:** Explain the difference between Task.Run and async/await.
Task.Run offloads work to thread pool. async/await is for I/O-bound operations without blocking threads. Use async/await for I/O, Task.Run for CPU-bound.
async/await is for asynchronous I/O operations. It doesn't block threads while waiting. Task.Run explicitly queues work to thread pool. Using Task.Run with async is an anti-pattern.
